**General Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer specializing in Generative AI to join our core AI team.

* Design and implement RAG\-based solutions to enhance LLM capabilities with external knowledge sources

* Create robust evaluation frameworks for measuring and improving model performance
* Build and maintain agentic workflows for autonomous AI systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities and implement AI solutions

**Responsibilities**
 The Data\-E\-commerce team oversees algorithmic and corresponding engineering work in the e\-commerce business. Our responsibilities encompass not only utilizing recommendation and search algorithms to help users discover appealing products but also implementing risk control and content safety algorithms to identify malicious sellers/influencers and violations in products/videos/live streams, ensuring a secure shopping experience. Furthermore, we are involved in constructing intelligent customer service technology and large\-scale product knowledge graphs, aiming to enhance efficiency across various transaction processes. Through operations optimization and intelligent supply chain algorithms, we work to improve logistics efficiency.
